instructions: Only records is imported. _guide is explanatory reference data.
Duplicate a records entry to capture another day or observation period.
Equipment entries are real observations linked to existing simulation equipment by equipmentId. They do not create or configure physical equipment.
Template IDs and names come from the currently selected simulation, including conveyors. Preserve IDs to match results.
All fields ending in Seconds use seconds. MTBF and MTTR use minutes. Display-unit choices do not change JSON units.
Use null for unknown numeric values and an empty string for unknown text. Zero is a measured zero.
EXAMPLE ONLY: durationSeconds=86400 means 24 hours; replace it if needed.

recordFields.id: Text identifier; fresh IDs are assigned on import.
recordFields.name: Required record title.
recordFields.notes: Free observations and unresolved definitions (up to 8000 characters).
recordFields.bottlesPerCase: Positive integer for case conversion, or null.
recordFields.referenceSpeedBpm: Confirmed ideal reference in bottles/min, or null. Not automatically the average running speed.
recordFields.reportedEfficiencyPercent: Source AU / efficiency in percent (0-100), or null. Its definition is not assumed to match OEE.
recordFields.qualityPercent: Observed quality in percent (0-100), or null.
recordFields.durationSeconds: Positive full observation period in seconds, or null.
recordFields.downtimeSeconds: Exclusive line downtime in seconds, or null.
recordFields.runTimeSeconds: Line run time in seconds, or null.
recordFields.effectiveRuntimeSeconds: Effective runtime in seconds, or null.
recordFields.updtSeconds: Source UPDT in seconds, or null; confirm its definition.
recordFields.rateLossSeconds: Equivalent rate-loss seconds, or null. Not automatically a full stop.
recordFields.sourceSnapshot: Optional original source text / serialized JSON. Empty when unavailable; up to 64000 characters.
recordFields.equipment: Array of observations, at most one entry per equipmentId in this period.
recordFields.lineTimeBasis: UNCONFIRMED (default), or OUTPUT_FLOW only after confirming: run time = positive flow at final output; downtime = full period minus run time; effective runtime = final bottles / reference bottles per second; UPDT = full period minus effective runtime (includes planned losses); rate loss = run time minus effective runtime.
recordFields.aem: Optional AEM calendar fields in seconds: businessExternalDowntimeSeconds, plantAvailableSeconds, plantDecisionDowntimeSeconds, productionAvailableSeconds; basis UNCONFIRMED / CALENDAR_OUTPUT_FLOW.
recordFields.shiftProduction: Up to 3 optional counts, in productionUnit.
recordFields.reportedProductionUnits: Source total production in base bottle units (optional).

equipmentFields.equipmentId: Required existing equipment ID. Matching uses this ID, not the display name.
equipmentFields.name: Equipment display name.
equipmentFields.exposureSeconds: Positive observed exposure period in seconds, or null.
equipmentFields.failureCount: Integer count of the selected stop class, or null.
equipmentFields.failureSeconds: Total seconds of the selected stop class, or null.
equipmentFields.mtbfMinutes: Observed MTBF in minutes, or null; compare with the configured input.
equipmentFields.mttrMinutes: Observed MTTR in minutes, or null; compare with the configured input.
equipmentFields.downtimeSeconds: Observed downtime for stopClass; seconds, not the sum of line losses.

syntheticEquipmentExample.name: Example filler
syntheticEquipmentExample.notes: Synthetic values for structure only; not measured plant data.

records.name: Production day
records.source: Enter the report, sheet or measurement reference
records.notes: Replace example labels and the 86400-second day with your observation. Unknown numeric values are null, not zero.
